movie_characters.description: The fun-loving, flirtatious rogue with a golden heart — his drunken water-tank proposal scene to Basanti is pure cinema gold.
The brooding, sharp-shooter best friend — calm, cool, and the silent backbone of the Veeru-Jai duo.
The ruthless dacoit whose terrifying laugh and dialogues like 'Kitne aadmi the?' became immortal in Indian pop culture.
The stoic ex-police officer seeking justice with a deep personal loss — his presence added gravitas to the story.
The chirpy, fearless tonga-driver whose non-stop chatter and brave spirit made her one of the most beloved heroines ever.
The silent widow with eyes full of unspoken emotions, embodying silent strength and resilience.
Gabbar's trusted lieutenant, mostly remembered for standing silently behind him and the legendary 'Samba, kitne aadmi the?' scene.
Another sidekick of Gabbar whose trembling fear during Gabbar's grilling made 'Tera kya hoga Kaalia' an iconic meme even decades later.
The hilarious timber merchant from Bhopal whose slow, exaggerated storytelling style became a cult favorite.
A ridiculous, British-era Jailor parodying Hitler — his 'HUM angrezon ke zamaane ke jailor hain' dialogue became legendary.
The blind elder of Ramgarh village, symbolizing wisdom, patience, and deep sorrow after personal loss.
Basanti’s hilarious, stern aunt — her no-nonsense attitude and arranged marriage scene added light moments.
The young and brave villager whose tragic death triggers the emotional revolt against Gabbar's tyranny.
